Tailgate for Windows (Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit)

Tailgate is a window onto Tailscale: it shows where your traffic is going, lists exit nodes
(including Mullvad's) with search and favorites, and switches them for you. It needs Tailscale
for Windows installed and signed in: https://tailscale.com/download/windows
Tailgate looks for it in C:\Program Files\Tailscale\tailscale.exe and on your PATH. If it can't
find it, the window says so and offers a link to the download.

Tailgate is a portable app: unzip this folder anywhere (Documents, Desktop) and double-click
Tailgate.exe. Nothing is installed and no admin rights are needed. To remove it, delete the
folder. Its few settings (favorites, theme) live in %APPDATA%\Tailgate.

First launch: Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Tailgate isn't
code-signed yet, so Windows doesn't recognise the publisher. Click "More info", check that the
app is Tailgate.exe, then click "Run anyway". Windows remembers this for this copy.

Changes go through Tailscale's own command line, as the Windows account you're signed in with.
Tailscale only takes changes from the account that's using it; if it refuses, Tailgate says so
and nothing changes. Tailgate never asks for admin rights.

Command line (PowerShell or cmd, in this folder): .\Tailgate.exe --help
.\Tailgate.exe --read-only opens the window with every change switched off.

Free and open source: https://github.com/nunyabiz765/tailgate
From Center Point Labs: https://centerpointlabs.dev/services/tailgate/
Not affiliated with Tailscale Inc. or Mullvad VPN AB.
